title: ICAB V3 - Case Study
format: Written & Capstone Strategic Simulation (Advance Information + Unseen)
summary: Capstone professional simulation requiring candidates to analyze advance business information, process unseen exam-day material, synthesize complex financial, strategic, ethical, and assurance challenges, and draft an executive report with actionable board recommendations.

all.name: Full Syllabus Tracker
all.blurb: Official 2025 Syllabus chapter and topic tracker for Case Study. Track your study progress across all syllabus areas.

stages.title: Area 1: Strategic Business Analysis & Environmental Evaluation
stages.name: Area 1: Strategic Business Analysis & Environmental Evaluation
stages.description: Deconstructing advance information, industry dynamics, competitive positioning, and SWOT synthesis.

nodes.name: Advance Information Analysis & Strategic Diagnosis
nodes.description: Scrutiny of Advance Information (AI); industry benchmark comparisons; business model identification; external threats and opportunities; internal operational bottlenecks; stakeholder power dynamics.
topics: Advance Information (AI) analytical methodology: Timeline, key actors, financial baseline
Industry analysis and macro-economic factors impacting the case entity
SWOT and PESTEL synthesis tailored to specific industry context
Competitor benchmarking and operational cost driver analysis
Identifying operational vulnerabilities, capacity constraints, and supply chain dependencies
learningOutcomes: Synthesize complex advance business data into a strategic diagnosis.
Benchmark operational performance against industry competitors.
Identify strategic threats requiring executive board intervention.
checklists: Read Advance Information Analysis & Strategic Diagnosis in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 2: Financial Analysis, Corporate Reporting & Forecasting
stages.name: Area 2: Financial Analysis, Corporate Reporting & Forecasting
stages.description: Unseen financial data processing, ratio interpretation, forecasting, and investment evaluation.

nodes.name: Financial Appraisal, Ratio Analysis & Sensitivity Modeling
nodes.description: Analysis of unseen financial exhibits; recalculating profitability, working capital cycles, and debt covenants; preparing financial projections; sensitivity analysis on proposed capital projects or acquisitions.
topics: Interpreting unseen financial information under strict exam time constraints
Recalculating key financial ratios: Gross margin, EBITDA margin, ROCE, interest cover, gearing
Evaluating financial projections and cash flow forecasts provided by management
Conducting sensitivity analysis on critical revenue, cost, and interest rate assumptions
Assessing impact on bank borrowing covenants and liquidity cushions
learningOutcomes: Extract and recalculate critical financial metrics from unseen exhibits.
Perform sensitivity analysis on proposed investments.
Evaluate loan covenant compliance under stressed scenarios.
checklists: Read Financial Appraisal, Ratio Analysis & Sensitivity Modeling in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 3: Assurance, Risk Management, Governance & Ethics
stages.name: Area 3: Assurance, Risk Management, Governance & Ethics
stages.description: Identifying hidden financial/operational risks, ethical conflicts, and internal control breakdowns.

nodes.name: Risk Evaluation, Internal Controls & Ethical Dilemmas
nodes.description: Identification and prioritization of strategic, operational, financial, and compliance risks; evaluation of internal control failures and fraud red flags; resolution of complex ethical dilemmas involving management pressure, confidentiality, and public interest.
topics: Enterprise risk mapping: Impact vs likelihood matrix for case enterprise
Identifying internal control deficiencies and accounting irregularities
Evaluating fraud indicators, whistleblowing reports, and related-party dealings
Ethical evaluation using IESBA fundamental principles and threat framework
Balancing commercial profitability with stakeholder welfare and legal compliance
learningOutcomes: Prioritize enterprise risks and design mitigating controls.
Identify and resolve complex professional ethical dilemmas.
Recommend governance enhancements to prevent corporate irregularities.
checklists: Read Risk Evaluation, Internal Controls & Ethical Dilemmas in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 4: Strategic Recommendations & Executive Report Writing
stages.name: Area 4: Strategic Recommendations & Executive Report Writing
stages.description: Report structure, professional tone, actionable recommendations, and implementation plan.

nodes.name: Professional Report Structure, Strategy & Implementation Plan
nodes.description: Structuring a formal board report (Title, Executive Summary, Introduction, Strategic Analysis, Financial Analysis, Strategic Options, Recommendations, Implementation Timetable); drafting persuasive, commercially realistic, and ethically sound recommendations.
topics: Formal report format: Title, To/From/Date/Subject, Executive Summary, Table of Contents
Drafting a concise Executive Summary capturing key findings and strategic proposals
Formulating 2 to 3 distinct strategic alternatives with pros, cons, and financial impacts
Justifying a definitive commercial recommendation with clear rationale
Developing a detailed implementation plan: Milestones, resource allocation, KPI targets, risk mitigation
Maintaining professional skepticism and executive communication tone throughout
learningOutcomes: Author a professional board-level report under strict time limits.
Provide clear, prioritized, and commercially viable strategic recommendations.
Design realistic implementation roadmaps with risk contingencies.
checklists: Read Professional Report Structure, Strategy & Implementation Plan in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)
